quest.title: The Illuminated Beast of the Sea of Clouds
quest.description: The three secretaries who originally worked at the Jade Chamber have appeared at Yujing Terrace. It looks like something has them tearing their hair out...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: Sea of Clouds, Sea of People

talks.objective: Talk to the Jade Chamber secretaries

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: It's shocking how much work there is to do, even for the three of us...

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: And she's been handling it alone all along... The Qixing's secretary clearly isn't an ordinary person. It's so frustrating...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Huh. You're...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aren't you Ningguang's servants? How come you're here?

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Ahem... We are Ms. Ningguang's private secretaries, not servants.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Have you seen Ms. Ganyu, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: It has been several days since Ganyu left for Jueyun Karst. She's the General Secretary of the Liyue Qixing. We've only taken over her responsibilities until she gets back...

choices.text: What happened?

response.speaker: Baixiao
response.text: Ah, even though the Qixing have made peace with the adepti after the latter had denounced Liyue, they still want to pay their respects to the illuminated ones...

response.speaker: Baixiao
response.text: They commissioned Ganyu as their envoy to deliver a letter to Jueyun Karst and bring the adepti the latest news about the crisis.

response.speaker: Baixiao
response.text: Still... Ganyu should have been back to her usual responsibilities by now, but she's disappeared without a trace.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that so... Maybe Ganyu just took a little detour? Who can blame her, after working so hard?

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: I'm afraid it's not very likely... Ever since we met Ms. Ganyu, she's been nothing but the most conscientious person in all of Liyue.

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: Even when it's time for her annual leave, Ms. Ganyu stays on duty at Yuehai Pavilion, saying that "there is still so much to do."

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: She couldn't possibly be using her mission as an excuse to slack off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon sees how it is... But she's half-adeptus. She wouldn't get in trouble, right? Why do you look so upset...

response.speaker: Baishi
response.text: Well... It's because of this absurd workload of hers!

response.speaker: Baishi
response.text: *sigh* When we first heard the three of us would be taking over for Ms. Ganyu, we thought it would simply be a matter of changing our work environment.

response.speaker: Baixiao
response.text: We couldn't have imagined that Ms. Ganyu's daily workload far exceeds what the three of us are used to doing.

choices.text: The adeptus lineage is truly remarkable.

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: Speaking of Jueyun Karst, Traveler, I've heard that you can go in and out of there as you please.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! We've been there lots of times.

response.speaker: Baixiao
response.text: Ah, that's good news... Could you go to Jueyun Karst and find Ms. Ganyu for us? Preferably before we collapse under this workload...

choices.text: Seems like I'm the only one who can do it, indeed...

response.speaker: Baixiao
response.text: Phew... We're saved. I remember Ms. Ganyu said that she'd be visiting Cloud Retainer's abode. You might as well start looking for her there.

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: It's about time she came back to work, otherwise... *sigh*

response.speaker: Baishi
response.text: No. Perhaps we should go to Lady Ningguang first and bring up our overtime pay again.

choices.text: I'll do it. Lives are at stake here.
Shouldn't you get back to work?

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: We don't even know how long we've been working... We feel guilty for taking even a short breather like we are now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like you've got a serious emergency on your hands.

choices.text: Why did she go to Jueyun Karst?

talks.objective: Head near Mt. Aocang to look for Ganyu

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ganyu! Here you are!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: You two... I did not expect to meet you here. Is it official or private affairs that bring you here?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ah, I shouldn't... I have left the human world. Please contact the Yuehai Pavilion regarding matters concerning the commercial port.

choices.text: Left the human world?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, you don't want to be the Qixing's secretary anymore? But they're all waiting for you to come back...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: That's why you're here? You want me to come back? I'm afraid you came here in vain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Did something happen?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The clouds fold and unfold, the tide ebbs and flows. It was meant to be.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: When the adepti entrusted humans with overseeing Liyue, I knew it was only a matter of time until I had to leave.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: My adepti blood makes me unwelcome in Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I delivered the letter and came back to Liyue Harbor only to discover that I had been replaced by Baiwen, Baixiao, and Baishi...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Perhaps that mission of mine was just a pretext to remove me. Since the Qixing gave me a chance to leave with dignity, I decided to be tactful, as well.

choices.text: I believe there's been a huge misunderstanding.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I appreciate your kindness but there's no need for your words of comfort.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: After a thousand years away, I came back to Jueyun Karst. Looking at the clouds floating among the mountains brings me peace of mind. I feel better now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, but...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Who disturbs the peace of these mountains?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cloud Retainer? We're terribly sorry, we just...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph, one merely jests! One felt your presence the moment you set foot upon this land.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you adepti really are impressive.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Come here to chat about the old times with Ganyu? It looks like you get along quite well...

choices.text: Chat about the old times?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ah... A matter leaves you at an impasse, then?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Not to worry, one is exceptional at seeking avenues for conversation. One has been one's own companion in idle talk for many a year.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ah, yes. Since you are Ganyu's friends, tales from her youth shall one apprise you of, perhaps...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Cloud Retainer!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hahaha... Nothing to be ashamed of! You were so cute as a child, one is most certain that your friends would like to hear of it.

choices.text: I'm a bit curious, indeed...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon wants to hear it!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Eh...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hehe... Little Ganyu loved when the horns on the top of her head were caressed.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: When one was still taking care of her, one was pestered most often to touch her horns. She was else-wise loath to sleep...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Plump she was, back then! Why, when she stumbled while we ascended the mountain, she would roll down to the bottom like a little ball...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—haha!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...The day Ganyu bumped into a pilgrim was the first time she saw a real human in the flesh.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: So fearful she was that she hid in a rock's cleft for two days and nights. One found her wailing of a monster she had seen...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hahaha...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: CLOUD RE—TAI—NER!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: *sigh* Forget it. It's about time for my training. I will take my leave!

choices.text: I think you upset Ganyu...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ah, one's intention was merely to relieve the awkward tension...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you did the exact opposite. Impressive.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Be that so? Huh...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: But returning to Ganyu, most gladdened one is of your arrival.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One cannot help but feel that remaining in Jueyun Karst shall not be good for her...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One will tell you more about her, if you should permit it.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One did, by chance, hear this much of Ganyu's thoughts.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Alone, she will find her predicament hard to conquer. One hopes that you will accompany her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Retainer's right! We can't leave Ganyu depressed like that. Besides, Liyue hasn't given up on her, she's got it all wrong...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyways, what's that "training" Ganyu was talking about?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: She has sought to reclaim her adeptus side since returning to Jueyun Karst. At her behest, one has organized training for her to achieve that end...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: She should be in the southern part of Mt. Aocang right now, preparing for the trial.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, is that so? Let's go take a look, then!

choices.text: It seems you didn't read the room...
Now that's a good topic.
Get along?
Nobody wants to get rid of you...
You seem different...

talks.objective: Head to the site of Ganyu's trial and speak to her

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So here you are, Ganyu!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Why did you come here?

choices.text: We want to keep you company.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ah, I... Humans should not remain in the realm of adepti for too long.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Hmm... Considering the kindness you have shown me, I can let you stay for the adeptus training.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay~!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: This trial was prepared by Cloud Retainer. Its goal is to help me feel like an adeptus again.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The training is much to her signature style... I hope it won't make it seem like she is too unaware of the abilities of others.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I—Is it difficult?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: No, I'm aware of your strength, Traveler. The power hidden within you is not inferior to mine.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: If you're ready, we shall begin the training.

choices.text: I'd like to try this adeptus training.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Is that so? You really are interested in the ways of adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You're half an hour late... I see you still haven't abandoned the wrongful ways of humankind.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I had a meeting with Cloud Retainer, I...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I don't need your explanations and don't require any mutual understanding between us. I'm just helping you with your training, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao is such a strict teacher.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You're neither an adeptus, nor a human, always treading the line between the two worlds. It must create a lot of confusion.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Instead of explaining yourself to me, you should face your true self.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I... I have nothing to hide.

choices.text: It seems that Xiao understands Ganyu quite well.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The body and the mind are one. If something worries your mind, your body can help you find a solution.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The trial I've prepared for you will explore the true potential of your body.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes, I'm ready.

choices.text: Xiao might be a good teacher after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: We've completed the task. What do you think?

choices.text: Perhaps I'd make a good adeptus.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I agree. You possess many qualities similar to those of adepti, despite having none of their blood.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ganyu, what were you planning to do once your training was over?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The training's not over yet. The part prepared by Cloud Retainer is only the first trial.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So there are more trials, prepared by other adepti?

choices.text: Is Mountain Shaper next?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: No. The only adeptus who can unlock my true potential is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who is it?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Conqueror of Demons.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh! So it's Xiao! That cold-hearted loner? How come he's prepared a trial for you?

choices.text: What a surprise...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I found him unapproachable at first, too. But I believe... that being able to face him is an important part of my "homecoming."

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: He's already waiting for me. Come along if you're interested.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Of course we are! Let's go, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: How interesting...
Is it Moon Carver?
Being an adeptus is not easy...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Hardships are a fact of life, both for the adepti and humans alike.

talks.objective: Go to Nantianmen and speak with Xiao

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Focus on the trial. I'm not here for idle chatter.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I've completed your trial.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You don't have to report back to me. Seeking other people's validation won't benefit your training.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Only you can evaluate the result of this trial. You'll progress faster that way.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Um... Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao always has such strong opinions.

choices.text: He could be nicer while sharing them.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: From tomorrow on, I'll start raising the difficulty of your training, so you'll have to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Have to do what?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Huh... Another one of those pesky visitors...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I'll leave him to you, Ganyu. It's also a part of your training.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pesky visitor? So even here there are those that Xiao can't deal with?

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Oh—Oh heavens! Blessed be Rex Lapis, I've finally come upon the adepti!

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Are all of you the adepti of this mountain?

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Great! My name's Xin Cheng. I came to ask for your merciful blessings, O adepti! I beg of you, please grant me luck, wealth, and a good career!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so it's a pilgrim.

choices.text: Such a materialist...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I... am also one of the adepti. You can say that I'm an adeptus in training.

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Perfect! I didn't come in vain then. Although you sound a bit half-hearted, eh... doesn't matter.

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: What blessings can you grant me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, straight to the point, huh?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Dear... pilgrim, you shouldn't jump to conclusions. Adepti don't help every pilgrim for free.

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: For free? Do you mean that you charge people for the blessings of the adepti?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ah, that's not what I meant. What I'm trying to say is that everything should be earned through hard work and earnest living...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It would be unfair to other people if you got everything you wanted for no reason.

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Hold on, hold on, I've heard this all before. You're just like my old man, always nagging me...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Your father must've experienced it firsthand. The lives of the common folk are riddled with hardships but are also full of joy.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: A person of your age should focus on work and family, instead of chasing after fairytales.

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Are you a real adeptus? Why do you speak and behave like us city folk?

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: You sure you're not of those swindlers who pose as an adeptus to cheat people out of their money?

choices.text: He just can't take criticism.

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Eh, enough. Doesn't matter if you're a real adeptus or not, you're useless. I'm leaving.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Nobody's stopping you!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Eh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ganyu, don't let that guy ruin your mood...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I—It's not his behavior. The things he said... He was right.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I thought that coming back to Jueyun Karst and devoting myself to training would make me feel like an adeptus again.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But being questioned by him made me realize that I...

choices.text: Go back to Liyue Harbor with us.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But... I'm unwelcome in Liyue Harbor. As an adeptus, I...

choices.text: We told you it was a misunderstanding!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's true! Just believe us!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Eh...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Alright, I'll go with you to Liyue Harbor. That said, I still trust my initial judgment.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: If I'm proven right, I'll return to Jueyun Karst once again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a step in the right direction. Let's go!

choices.text: Can you believe a human like me just this once?
You're better off sticking to your human side.
Show some respect!

response.speaker: Xin Cheng
response.text: Ugh... How dare you reprove me! I bet you came here looking for the adepti yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, he might sorta have a point. We did come here looking for Ganyu, after all.

choices.text: I can see why Xiao finds his type troublesome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, he can handle any battle, but talking to strange humans is a different story, huh...

choices.text: That lone wolf is truly admirable.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: This trial will test her spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Even so, one hopes that it shall trouble her little...
